mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week rise in TRANSIT stations mobility from -53.6 to -46.3 signals relaxation of movement restrictions and recovering commuting, which in turn lifts weekday retail and recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -53.6 to -46.3 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT continuing to rise or holding above -47.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates that both commuting and office presence are returning, and their interaction amplifies weekday retail and recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stabilized at -19.1 for two weeks
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve or hold at these levels but RETAIL_REC next 28 days is not higher than last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly PARKS rebound greater than 8 percentage points indicates eased outdoor restrictions and renewed discretionary trips, which spill into adjacent retail and recreation within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -21.9 to -10.9 in the latest week
failure_condition: If PARKS rebounds by more than 8 percentage points week-on-week but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-lockdown reopening, RESIDENTIAL declining from 8.1 to 5.1 shows people leaving home, and with TRANSIT still below -45 the marginal trips concentrate in local retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 8.1 to 5.1 over four weeks
failure_condition: In a post-lockdown reopening, if RESIDENTIAL falls below 5.1 while TRANSIT stays above -48 and RETAIL_REC next 28 days is lower.

mechanism_narrative: The seasonal transition toward spring in Melbourne raises PARKS and outdoor recreation independently of policy, and this seasonal outdoor activity historically spills into retail and recreation over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS one-week rebound to -10.9 is consistent with early spring
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above -15 over the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing above zero signals that precautionary pantry stocking has normalized and households are shifting spending toward discretionary retail, producing higher RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM turned positive at 0.7 in the latest week
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0 for the next week but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Continued WORKPLACES stabilization at about -19 while RESIDENTIAL falls from 6.4 to 5.1 indicates office return from remote work, and this interaction raises lunchtime and after-work retail trips over two weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES holds at or above -19.1 while RESIDENTIAL falls to 5.1 or lower but RETAIL_REC next 28 days is not higher.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -45 for two consecutive weeks, residual movement restrictions cap retail recovery and the reopening bounce fades, keeping RETAIL_REC below its last four-week mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT stays below -45 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.
